New collection · Ten original works · Forthcoming

What We Make of Free Rein

A ten-piece contemporary collection of modern, expressive paintings exploring the figure, nature, light and the freedom to create, grow and define a life of our own making.

The collection

Ten paintings, one at a time

The works in What We Make of Free Rein are in progress in Kimberly’s studio in Irvine, California. Each original will be added here as it is finished and catalogued, with its medium, dimensions and price.

Originals are one of a kind and come with a signed certificate of authenticity and free insured shipping in the US.
